alloy.name: Alloy billets
alloy.description: Structural feedstock. Exporting home reserves competes with construction.

water.name: Purified water
water.description: Bulk life-support water. Glacial producers supply thirsty dry worlds.

glass.name: Resonant glass
glass.description: Heat-grown crystal used in sensors. Arid deposits supply colder worlds.

defender.name: Defender
defender.description: Neutralize distinct hostile ships. Revisiting a cleared encounter never counts again.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: Complete distinct commodity deliveries between different worlds. Each origin, destination and commodity combination counts once.

heat_ray.name: Heat ray
heat_ray.description: Raises global temperature by 10 over eight seconds. 25 energy per pulse. Does not stabilize an ecosystem.

cool_ray.name: Refrigeration ray
cool_ray.description: Lowers global temperature by 10 over eight seconds. 25 energy per pulse.

cloud_accumulator.name: Cloud accumulator
cloud_accumulator.description: Raises global atmosphere by 10 over eight seconds. 20 energy per pulse.

cloud_vacuum.name: Cloud vacuum
cloud_vacuum.description: Lowers global atmosphere by 10 over eight seconds. 20 energy per pulse.

seeker.name: Seeker missile launcher
seeker.description: Homing missiles for flying surface targets. 45 damage, 14 energy, two-second flight, four-second cycle.

ground_bomb.name: Ground bomb bay
ground_bomb.description: Delayed ground-area strike. 50 damage within 7 m, 18 energy, four-second cycle. Does not hit flyers.

hold.name: Expanded cargo hold
hold.description: Raises commodity capacity from 8 to 16 units. Specimen cradles and energy packs have separate storage.

emitter.name: Focused arc emitter
emitter.description: Raises arc-lance damage from 22 to 33. Energy cost, reach and cooldown stay unchanged.

drive.name: Extended-range drive
drive.description: Raises jump range from 3 to 5 links. Energy consumption stays at 8 per link.

hull_1.name: Hull reinforcement I
hull_1.description: 150 maximum hull. Current hull is preserved; repairs still cost energy.

hull_2.name: Hull reinforcement II
hull_2.description: 225 maximum hull. A stronger frame for sustained expeditions.

hull_3.name: Hull reinforcement III
hull_3.description: 325 maximum hull. Installation does not repair existing damage.

hull_4.name: Hull reinforcement IV
hull_4.description: 450 maximum hull. Repair and recovery costs remain meaningful.

energy_1.name: Reactor reservoir I
energy_1.description: 150 maximum energy. Additional capacity is empty until recharged.

energy_2.name: Reactor reservoir II
energy_2.description: 225 maximum energy. Packs still restore 50; equipment costs stay unchanged.

energy_3.name: Reactor reservoir III
energy_3.description: 325 maximum energy. Foreign docks bill for each missing unit.

energy_4.name: Reactor reservoir IV
energy_4.description: 450 maximum energy. No passive regeneration; homeworld recharge remains free.
